canonical_scenarios: Same seed on both native platforms
Unused final interval cannot prolong the task
Response dispatched within the final drain
Partial run stopped after ten scored trials
Navigation overlay cannot preserve an active scored run
Actual taps in a JavaScript preview
Mixed guest demo preserves real native evidence
Passing native build without physical timing tests
Development threshold and terminal boundaries are exercised
